name: Sruth nam Fear Gorm
text: Sruth nam Fear Gorm is a Gaelic place-name of the Hebridean seas. It names the stream of the blue men. The dictionary prints the head as a plain cross-reference. The fuller record belongs to the Blue Men of the Minch node.
